events.event_name: Apothékary x Ulta Beauty Upper East Side Wellness Event
events.address: Ulta Beauty, 188 E 86th St, New York, NY 10028
events.what_it_is: A one-day Apothékary wellness activation at Ulta Beauty with tongue-reading consultations, product sampling, personalized routine guidance and a complimentary matcha station.
events.what_is_free: Product sampling, tongue-reading consultations, personalized routine guidance and complimentary matcha; a gift with purchase is also offered while supplies last.
events.caveats: Apothékary's current brand post explicitly advertises an RSVP, but the search-accessible source exposes it only through a LinkedIn short link rather than a stable direct registration URL. Do not invent a destination URL. The complimentary gift requires purchase and is while supplies last; the sampling, consultations and matcha are described separately from that purchase offer.
events.practical_notes: Thursday, September 17, 11 AM–5 PM at Ulta Beauty Upper East Side, 188 E 86th St.

events.event_name: A Drop of Japan: Apothékary x SUKOSHI Pop-Up
events.what_it_is: A three-day Japanese-wellness-themed Apothékary takeover of SUKOSHI with tongue readings, tincture sampling, ingredient education and kakigori shaved ice.
events.what_is_free: Tincture samples and kakigori while supplies last; the first 50 guests in line each day receive a complimentary mini Apothékary tincture.
events.caveats: Eventbrite lists multiple dates and is organized by Apothékary. Complimentary minis are limited to the first 50 guests in line each day and kakigori is while supplies last. The 20% discount and separate gift-with-purchase offer are retail promotions, not conditions of admission.
events.practical_notes: Friday, September 18 runs 1 PM–9 PM; Saturday and Sunday, September 19–20, run 9 AM–9 PM. Each date is represented separately below.

events.what_it_is: A two-day immersive café created by Oatly and Korean-American artist and producer Yaeji, inspired by Korean dabangs.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary iced Gochujang Lattes made with espresso, Oatly Barista Edition, gochujang-vanilla, salted vanilla cold foam and gochugaru.
events.caveats: Two current independent event sources agree on the dates, hours, address, free lattes and open-public access. No advance RSVP requirement is published in those verified sources. An official Oatly event page was not located in this pass, so the listing retains the source limitation rather than inventing one.
events.practical_notes: Saturday and Sunday, September 19–20, 9 AM–3 PM at 48 Ludlow St. Complimentary drinks are promotional inventory and may be limited.

events.address: September 17: Sephora Union Square and Sephora 34th Street; September 18: Sephora SoHo, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: A Fable & Mane in-store Sephora tour stop with co-founder Akash Mehta, product ritual education, complimentary samples and gifts with purchase while supplies last.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary product samples; gifts with purchase are separately offered while supplies last.
events.caveats: Current event listings describe the Sephora stops as open to the public. Complimentary samples are separate from gifts with purchase. Exact per-store hours were not independently established in this pass, so no unsupported end time is invented.
events.practical_notes: September 17: Sephora Union Square and Sephora 34th Street. September 18: Sephora SoHo. Check the source before traveling for store-specific timing because the current source groups the tour stops under one listing.
